lines.text: Many learners say: She speaks more better than me.
Better: She speaks better than me.
Better! This is better than that.

data.wrong: She speaks more better than me.

native.tip: “Better” já é comparativo. Não precisa de “more”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “She speaks more better than me.”. O certo é “She speaks better than me.”. É a versão do “mais melhor” do português. Ouça o Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “better”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: “Better” is already a comparative. You do not need “more”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “She speaks more better than me.”. The right way is “She speaks better than me.”. It is the English version of Portuguese “mais melhor”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
